name: add-css-constructed
description: add a CSS to document or specified target using constructed stylesheet with fallback

scripts.build:umd: esbuild src/main.js --format=iife --global-name=addCSS --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/umd.js && node src/umd-process.js dist/umd.js addCSS
